SELECT lifecycle.tenant_id, lifecycle.tenant_code, lifecycle.display_name, lifecycle.status, lifecycle.version, lifecycle.created_at, COALESCE(MAX(outbox.occurred_at), lifecycle.created_at) AS last_changed_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership WHERE membership.tenant_id = lifecycle.tenant_id AND membership.membership_role = 'TENANT_ADMINISTRATOR') AS administrator_count FROM organization_access.tenant_lifecycle lifecycle LEFT JOIN organization_access.tenant_lifecycle_outbox outbox ON outbox.tenant_id = lifecycle.tenant_id
(lifecycle.tenant_code ILIKE #{queryPattern} ESCAPE '\' OR lifecycle.display_name ILIKE #{queryPattern} ESCAPE '\')
AND lifecycle.status = #{status}
GROUP BY lifecycle.tenant_id, lifecycle.tenant_code, lifecycle.display_name, lifecycle.status, lifecycle.version, lifecycle.created_at ORDER BY last_changed_at DESC, lifecycle.tenant_id DESC
